title: Elon Musk praises Mythos/Fable, promises not to ‘cut off’ Anthropic
brief: Elon Musk publicly praised Mythos/Fable and promised not to "cut off" Anthropic from xAI infrastructure, addressing concerns about hosting Anthropic's models on xAI's servers with $40 billion in potential revenue at stake. The statement aims to reassure Anthropic about the viability of a partnership between the companies.
